hero.text: I support you **before and after your operation** for an optimal recovery, **working closely with your surgeon**. Appointments in Lyon 1 and Saint-Cyr-au-Mont-d'Or.

steps.title: Pre-operative assessment
steps.text: Understanding your operation and preparing your body: drainage, exercises, advice.

steps.title: The operation
steps.text: Your surgeon operates and gives you the prescription for physical therapy.

steps.title: Post-operative care
steps.text: Assessment, then adapted drainage, taping and scar work.

steps.title: Back to your activities
steps.text: A gradual return to movement and sport, at the pace of your recovery.

protocol.title: The treatments in your protocol
protocol.subtitle: Chosen after the assessment, depending on your operation and the condition of your tissues.

items.title: Lymphatic drainage
items.text: Manual, adapted to your tissues, to reduce swelling and prevent fibrosis.

items.title: Manual therapy
items.text: Hands-on techniques to restore tissue mobility and relieve tension.

items.title: Taping
items.text: To support the tissues and help the swelling go down.

items.title: Scars
items.text: Targeted work to make them more supple and improve their appearance.

items.title: Movement
items.text: Gentle rehabilitation to regain mobility and muscle tone.

items.title: Advice
items.text: Compression, lifestyle, return to sport: personalized support.

items.title: LPG
items.text: A mechanical technique that complements the manual work on the tissues.

items.title: Photobiomodulation (LED)
items.text: A light-based treatment, alongside the protocol.

interventions.title: The operations I work with
interventions.subtitle: These ranges are a guide, as every recovery is unique. The number of sessions also depends on how many areas were operated on: we set it together at the assessment, and it is then specified in your quote.

reconstructive.title: Reconstructive surgery

items.question: How soon after the operation can I start?
items.answer: As soon as your surgeon agrees, usually between day 3 and day 15 depending on the operation and the surgeon's practice.

items.question: Do I need a prescription?
items.answer: Yes, always. Operated on in France: a prescription from your surgeon or your GP. Operated on abroad: a prescription from a French doctor.

items.question: How many sessions should I plan for?
items.answer: Every recovery is unique: the number of sessions depends on the operation, how many areas were operated on, the swelling and how quickly you recover. As a guide: 6 to 20 sessions after chin liposuction only, 5 to 12 after a facelift, 10 to 20 after a tummy tuck, 10 to 25 after abdominal liposuction combined with a tummy tuck or after lipedema liposuction. After liposuction, the usual frequency is three sessions a week in the first month, two in the second, then one in the third. The exact number is set at the assessment and specified in your quote.

items.question: Is the treatment reimbursed?
items.answer: Only if the surgery itself is covered by the French national health insurance (reconstructive surgery), and in that case in Saint-Cyr-au-Mont-d'Or. After cosmetic surgery, the treatment is not reimbursed. For reconstructive surgery, some additional treatments outside the national fee schedule may be offered with a quote: they are not reimbursed by the Assurance Maladie, but are sometimes partly covered by complementary health insurers (mutuelles).

items.question: Can I start before I have a date for my operation?
items.answer: Yes. For a suitable pre-operative protocol, I recommend an assessment about 6 weeks before the operation.

items.question: Where do the sessions take place?
items.answer: In Lyon 1 (Coream, 22 rue Pizay) or in Saint-Cyr-au-Mont-d'Or (La Villa des Monts d'Or, 15 route de Lyon). Reimbursed treatment takes place in Saint-Cyr-au-Mont-d'Or.
